articles.summary: arXiv:2507.14121v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) parameterize each connection as a learnable univariate B-spline, offering native feature-level interpretability. Whether this locality helps or hinders under class imbalance, where minority sparsity may leave spline edges without enough local observations to update reliably, remains unexamined. articles.summary: arXiv:2611.20603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Drug combination therapy has become a mainstream of modern medicine, with the potential to enhance efficacy, reduce toxicity, and overcome drug resistance. articles.summary: arXiv:2611.19166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Every medication comes with two types of medical facts: indications, which describe what conditions the drug treats (benefits), and contraindications, which describe who must avoid it to prevent serious harm (safety limits). articles.summary: arXiv:2611.20402v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A Koopman controller can stabilize its learned latent-space linear model yet fail to stabilize the nonlinear plant. He’s always asking what more we can do.” Four years on from that unexpected email, Fiesser was given the secret task of reaching out for a letter for Saka to read from the podium when he was presented with the Sócrates award at last month’s Ballon d’Or ceremony in London for his humanitarian work.
